title: The Nobel Prize in Chemistry
The Nobel Prize in Chemistry
deck: 回看授奖之前的候选人与研究领域预测。
Candidate and research-field forecasts before the award.
about: 这一专题保留既有的年度档案、真实得主、候选人的研究方向和所属机构。各平台分别展示，个人预测与领域预测明确区分。
This topic retains the annual archive, actual laureates, candidate research and affiliations. Sources and individual versus field predictions remain distinct.
questions: 当时哪些人或研究方向受到关注？
Which people or fields attracted attention?
不同平台如何判断，最终结果是什么？
How did sources differ, and what happened?

title: 全固态电池
Solid-state batteries
deck: 成分验证、样品生产与客户交付，各自需要什么证据？
Composition tests, sample production and customer delivery require different evidence.
about: “固态”描述电解质体系，并不直接回答电芯中是否含锂、能量密度有多高，或是否已进入量产。本专题把检测指标与工程事件分开。涉及 Donut Lab 的题目反映各自创建者的规则；受委托的测试结果只覆盖报告实际测量的项目。

Solid-state refers to the electrolyte system; it does not establish lithium content, energy density or production readiness. This topic separates measurements from engineering milestones. Commissioned testing covers the measurements actually reported.
questions: 被测电池能否与商品或交付样品对应？
Can the tested cell be linked to the product?
电芯指标、电池包指标和整车表现有没有混用？
Are cell, pack and vehicle measures being conflated?
宣布产能、开始生产、实际交付分别到了哪一步？
What is announced capacity, operating production or delivery?

title: 如何比较不同电池测试
Comparing battery tests
body: 能量密度要说明测的是活性材料、电芯还是整包，以及质量和体积的分母。快充测试还需同时查看温度、充电区间、倍率及循环后的容量保持；单次充电时间无法代表长期寿命。

Energy density needs a material, cell or pack boundary and a mass or volume denominator. Fast-charge comparisons need temperature, state-of-charge range, rate and capacity retention; a single charging time is not lifetime.

title: 从送样到客户交付
From samples to delivery
body: 材料检测、电芯送样、客户认证、产线调试与零售交付是不同阶段。企业公告中的目标年份应作为当时的计划阅读，完成情况以具体产品、批次和客户记录为准。
Materials testing, cell samples, qualification, commissioning and retail delivery are different stages. Announced years are targets; completion needs product, batch and customer records.

title: 界面阻抗与循环寿命
Interface impedance and cycle life
body: 固态界面需要保持接触并控制副反应。高能量密度结果应与堆压、温度、循环倍率、面容量和终止条件一起阅读；此处不从单次放电结果推算长期循环寿命。

Solid interfaces need sustained contact and controlled side reactions. Energy results require pressure, temperature, rate, areal capacity and endpoint context; single-discharge results do not establish cycle lifetime.

title: 继续查阅其他电池体系
Other battery chemistries
body: 新增钠离子及动力电池与规模储能专题，单独讨论载流离子、正极份额、单体性能、整包成本和液流电解液。不同体系按各自来源和测试条件查阅。
New sodium-ion and EV/grid-storage topics separately cover charge carriers, cathode share, cells, pack costs and flow electrolytes under their own source conditions.

title: A 样耐久性与量产交付
A-sample durability and production delivery
body: PowerCo 披露的 >1,000 次循环、>95% 容量与 24 层结构应配对阅读，属于同一 A 样阶段的合作伙伴测试。样品性能之后还要看良率、压力与温度窗口、整包集成及客户验收；既有市场的 1 GWh 产能、汽车交付和商品可买分别有不同门槛。

Read PowerCo’s >1,000 cycles, >95% retention and 24 layers as one partner-tested A-sample stage. Yield, operating pressure/temperature, pack integration and acceptance follow. Capacity, vehicle delivery and retail availability remain separate contract thresholds.

label: DL6 电芯质量比能量
DL6 cell specific energy
scope: 单个客户送检电芯；+25 °C、0.1C、第二次放电。
One submitted cell; +25 °C, 0.1C, second discharge.

label: DL6 电芯体积能量密度
DL6 volumetric energy density
scope: 与质量比能量为同一测试；不代表整包或批量寿命。
Same cell test; not pack performance or production lifetime.

label: 送检组分锂含量
Submitted-parts lithium
scope: ICP-OES；一个电芯的送检组分，不含外包装。
ICP-OES on submitted parts from one cell, excluding pouch.

label: 送检组分钠含量
Submitted-parts sodium
scope: 元素含量不能单独确定电解质或储能机理。
Elemental content alone does not identify electrolyte or storage mechanism.

label: A 样电芯循环数
A-sample charging cycles
scope: PowerCo 实验室的合作伙伴测试，非量产车队统计。
Partner laboratory test, not production-fleet statistics.

label: 测试后容量保持率
Post-test capacity retention
scope: 与同次 >1,000 次循环记录配对；充放电全部条件查原文，不作为跨材料统一排名。
Paired with the >1,000-cycle record; consult the original for conditions, not a cross-material ranking.

label: 受测电芯层数
Tested cell layers
scope: A 样电芯结构；层数本身不证明良率或客户交付。
A-sample structure; layer count establishes neither yield nor delivery.

title: 室温超导
Room-temperature superconductors
deck: 从独立复现实验，到常压器件的商业应用。
From independent replication to commercial ambient-pressure devices.
about: 零电阻、磁响应、相变和样品成分共同构成核对线索，悬浮视频本身不足以替代完整表征。LK-99 的历史题目还展示了“有人做了复现实验”“实验支持超导”和“商品采用超导体”之间的区别。这里保留各题不同的温度、压力、时间边界和取消状态。

Zero resistance, magnetic response, transitions and sample composition need joint review; levitation alone is insufficient. LK-99 contracts distinguish replication attempts, successful replication and commercial adoption. Contract-specific definitions and cancellations remain visible.
questions: 题目要求的是实验发表，还是成功复现？
Does the contract ask for publication or successful replication?
室温与常压的数值范围如何定义？
How are temperature and pressure defined?
条件市场的前提失败后，是 No 还是取消？
Does a failed condition mean No or cancellation?

title: 判断超导需要哪些测量
Measurements for superconductivity
body: 电阻下降需要与磁性测量、样品组成及测量条件结合。杂相引起的输运异常或局部悬浮不能单独确立体相超导；可复现的温度、压力、磁场和临界电流是核心记录。

Resistance changes need magnetic, compositional and experimental context. Impurity-related anomalies or partial levitation alone do not establish bulk superconductivity; reproducible temperature, pressure, field and critical-current records matter.

title: 材料发现与商品应用
Materials discovery and products
body: 高温超导线材已有低温应用，室温市场则通常另有温度与压力门槛。短样、连续线材和整机产品的制造要求不同，不能把已有低温产品当作常温商业化的完成证明。
HTS conductors have cryogenic applications; ambient-temperature contracts impose different thresholds. Short samples, long tapes and complete devices also need different manufacturing evidence.

title: 复现次数与延期条款
Replication counts and extension clauses
body: 新增历史市场要求两次独立复现，并在可信度争议时允许等待期刊发表。读曲线时可沿成交日期回看预印本、独立样品与杂相解释，但不能把上涨、悬浮演示或某一个电阻突变替代成完整超导证据。

The added archive requires two independent replications and permits a publication extension in a credibility dispute. Compare trade dates with preprints, independent samples and impurity explanations; price moves, levitation or one resistance anomaly are not full superconducting evidence.

title: 碳捕集与 MOF
Carbon capture & MOFs
deck: 把材料供应、捕集过程和实际运行区分开来看。
Distinguish material supply, capture processes and operating deployment.
about: MOF 的开放孔隙可以通过节点与配体化学进行调节，但过程表现还取决于成型、湿度、再生和循环条件。BASF 与 Svante 的 CALF-20 供应合作是可查的产业资料，不等于某个装置已经实现公告中的所有目标。本次 Manifold 检索未找到可核验的 Svante、Atoco 或 MOF 专用产业事件；下列相关市场分别涉及生物分子与矿物风化，不被标成 MOF 赔率。

MOF pores are chemically tunable, while process performance also depends on shaping, humidity, regeneration and cycling. The BASF–Svante CALF-20 supply agreement is documented industrial evidence, not proof of every deployment target. This Manifold search found no verified Svante, Atoco or MOF-specific industrial contract. Related protein and mineral-weathering contracts below are not labelled MOF odds.
questions: 供应材料或建成产线，是否等于实际捕集量？
Does material supply or a factory establish captured tonnage?
捕集的 CO₂ 是否进一步储存，边界是否相同？
Is captured CO₂ stored, and are boundaries comparable?
相关预测究竟涉及哪一种材料路线？
Which material pathway does each forecast concern?

title: 捕集与净移除分别计量
Capture and net removal
body: 烟气捕集处理工业排放，直接空气捕集处理低浓度空气。永久移除还涉及能源排放、运输与封存；仅有吸附容量、设备能力或捕集量，不能直接给出净移除量。

Flue-gas capture and direct air capture treat different concentrations. Permanent removal also needs energy emissions, transport and storage accounting; capacity or gross capture alone does not give net removal.

title: MOF 的制造与运行证据
MOF manufacturing and operation
body: CALF-20 的供应合作可用于了解吸附剂如何进入制造链。材料放大之后，还需要结构化、循环再生、耐湿和装置运行资料；本专题其他路线的预测概率不代表 MOF 本身的成功率。

CALF-20 supply agreements show manufacturing integration. Scale-up additionally needs forming, cyclic regeneration, humidity resistance and plant operation; probabilities for other routes do not estimate MOF success.

title: 碳利用、净移除与设备商业化
Utilization, net removal and equipment sales
body: CO₂ 制甲烷市场补充电解—空气捕集—Sabatier 工艺，预测的是设备合同。燃烧后返回大气的碳不能记成永久移除；企业捕集成本也不能直接与含安全储存和 MRV 的每净吨目标比较。本站将这一利用路线与 MOF 分离材料、酶膜和矿化分别说明。

The added CO₂-to-methane market follows electrolysis, DAC and Sabatier integration but asks about equipment contracts. Fuel carbon returns to the atmosphere; capture-only cost differs from net-removal cost including storage/MRV. This route stays distinct from MOF separation, enzyme membranes and mineralization.

label: Mammoth 名义捕集能力
Mammoth nameplate capture
scope: 设计能力，不是实测净移除或核证交付量。
Design capacity, not measured net removal or verified deliveries.

label: 启动时已安装收集模块
Collectors installed at startup
scope: 已安装 / 计划总量；只描述启动节点。
Installed / planned total; describes that historical milestone.

label: 示范产品甲烷含量
Demonstrator methane content
scope: 企业称产品为管道级天然气；不是本市场设备交易证明或净移除量。
Company-described pipeline-grade gas; not equipment-sale evidence or net removal.

label: 企业披露制氢成本
Company-disclosed hydrogen cost
scope: 同文假设光伏直流电价 20 美元/MWh，非独立审计或最终客户报价。
The post assumes $20/MWh solar DC; not independent audit or an end-customer quotation.

label: 企业披露空气捕集成本
Company-disclosed DAC cost
scope: 仅该企业捕集口径，不是含永久储存的每净吨成本。
Company capture boundary, not cost per net tonne including permanent storage.

label: Carbon Negative Shot 净移除成本目标
Carbon Negative Shot net-removal cost goal
scope: 组合研发目标，包含安全储存与 MRV，不是已测得的行业均价。
Portfolio development goal including storage and MRV, not an observed industry average.

title: 聚变发电
Fusion power
deck: 从实验能量增益到并网供电，还隔着哪些工程环节？
From experimental gain to grid electricity: the engineering steps in between.
about: 聚变实验的能量增益、整机净发电、商业供电和电网占比是不同指标。这里分别收录 Helion 的特定交付事件与美国长期供电占比预测。
Experimental gain, net electricity, commercial delivery and grid share measure different outcomes. This topic separates a Helion delivery contract from a long-horizon US grid-share forecast.
questions: 净增益的输入和输出，在哪里计量？
Where are energy inputs and outputs measured?
购电协议中的计划，是否已有实际供电记录？
Does the purchase agreement have measured delivery records?
装机功率与年度发电量占比有什么差别？
How does capacity differ from annual generation share?

title: 从实验指标到电站指标
From experimental to plant metrics
body: 聚变电站需要持续或重复输出、净电力计量、维护与燃料供应。一次成功实验只能回答其特定工况下的问题，供电规模还要看可用率、厂用电和并网记录。

Fusion plants need repeatable output, net-electricity accounting, maintenance and fuel supply. A successful shot answers a narrower question; supply scale needs availability, auxiliary consumption and grid records.

title: 50 MW 与美国 2% 是不同事件
50 MW and 2% of US supply differ
body: 前者是特定供应商的客户交付，后者是全行业在美国供电中的份额。装机功率不等于年度发电量；长期占比题目的统计口径不足之处保留在规则核查中。
One concerns delivery by a named supplier; the other concerns an industry’s share of US electricity. Capacity differs from annual energy; missing definitions remain flagged.

title: 靶增益与电站净输出
Target gain and net electrical output
body: 新增 NIF 历史曲线围绕 2023 年实验能量，补上到靶输入与聚变输出的成对数据。原题“net gain >200%”存在定义歧义，保留平台判定；商业购电市场仍要求符合自身的交付功率、期限和设施条件，两者不合成统一聚变成功率。

The NIF archive pairs 2023 on-target input and fusion output, retaining the source outcome and its ambiguous net-gain percentage. Power-purchase markets retain separate power, deadline and facility requirements; no pooled fusion-success probability is calculated.

label: NIF 到靶激光能量
NIF on-target laser energy
scope: 一次惯性约束实验的输入；不含整个设施耗电。
Input to one inertial-confinement shot; excludes whole-facility electricity.

label: NIF 聚变输出能量
NIF fusion energy output
scope: 与 2.05 MJ 到靶输入配对；不是输出电能、全年最高值或持续发电能力。
Paired with 2.05 MJ on-target input; not electricity, a full-year maximum or continuous generation.

title: 量子纠错计算
Error-corrected quantum computing
deck: 逻辑比特、长电路和商业可用，分别如何验证？
Logical qubits, long circuits and commercial availability require different tests.
about: 增加物理比特数量并不等于获得更多可用逻辑比特。专题围绕纠错能力、长电路运行与商业可用性整理市场规则，保留“已停盘但未判定”等原平台状态。

More physical qubits do not automatically provide more usable logical qubits. Contracts concern correction, long circuits and commercial availability; closed but unresolved records retain their source status.
questions: 实验展示的是逻辑存储还是逻辑门运算？
Does the experiment demonstrate memory or logical gates?
一亿个门的口径与第三方验证要求是什么？
How are 100 million gates defined and independently verified?
商业可用需要哪些产品和访问证据？
What product and access records establish commercial availability?

title: 纠错实验之外还需要什么
Beyond correction experiments
body: 通用容错计算还需验证逻辑门、读出、解码延迟和长电路累计错误。不同硬件路线与编码方案的资源开销不同，物理比特数、逻辑比特数和可执行门数应分别列出。

General fault-tolerant computing also needs logical gates, readout, decoding latency and accumulated circuit errors. Hardware and code overhead vary; physical qubits, logical qubits and executable gates are separate metrics.

title: 商业可用的证据
Evidence of commercial availability
body: 产品上线、付费访问条件、用户能运行的任务和独立使用记录，比路线图更接近“可用”的含义。规则没有写明的性能阈值不能由本站补造；停盘未判定的事件继续保留未判定状态。
Product access terms, runnable tasks and independent usage matter beyond roadmaps. We do not invent absent performance thresholds, and closed unresolved contracts remain unresolved.

title: 从物理门到逻辑纠错
From physical gates to logical correction
body: 并行双比特门市场补充硬件层证据：门对数、平均保真度、串扰和 SPAM 处理。中性原子论文的 60 个原子与 99.5% 不能换写成 60 个逻辑比特或 ≥99.9%。逻辑纠错市场仍需看随码距增大时的逻辑错误变化，而不是只看某次物理门峰值。

The parallel-gate archive adds pairs, mean fidelity, crosstalk and SPAM boundaries. Sixty atoms at 99.5% does not mean sixty logical qubits or ≥99.9%. Error-correction contracts instead need logical-error scaling with code distance, not a best physical gate.

label: 并行双比特纠缠门保真度
Parallel two-qubit entangling fidelity
scope: 中性原子实验，多种重复门评估；低于本市场 99.9% 门槛。
Neutral-atom experiment using repeated-gate benchmarks; below the contract’s 99.9%.

label: 并行门操作的原子规模
Atoms involved in parallel operation
scope: 原子数量，不是 60 对门或 60 个逻辑量子比特。
Atom count, not sixty gate pairs or logical qubits.

title: 钙钛矿光伏
Perovskite photovoltaics
deck: 从首批叠层组件出货，到年度 GW 规模与全球装机份额。
From first tandem shipments to annual GW-scale sales and global deployment share.
about: 钙钛矿吸收层可以与硅电池叠层，提高光谱利用率。小面积电池效率、整块组件效率、工厂产能和实际出货是四种不同数据；本专题关注商业交付与部署规模。

A perovskite absorber can be stacked on silicon to use more of the spectrum. Small-cell efficiency, module efficiency, factory capacity and shipments are distinct; this topic follows commercial delivery and deployment.
questions: 效率记录对应电池还是完整组件？
Does the efficiency record concern a cell or a full module?
年度出货是否达到 1 GW，并附有可接受的质保？
Do annual shipments reach 1 GW with bankable warranties?
全球部署占比以哪个年度、哪个分母统计？
Which year and denominator define global deployment share?

title: 稳定性与质保
Durability and warranties
body: 光、热、湿度、偏压及其组合会影响材料和器件寿命。商业组件需要封装、户外数据、衰减模型与质保支持；较高初始效率不能替代长期发电可靠性。

Light, heat, humidity, bias and combined stress affect lifetime. Commercial modules need packaging, field data, degradation models and warranties; initial efficiency does not establish long-term reliability.

title: 如何核对 GW 级交付
Checking GW-scale delivery
body: 核对的是单一制造商在一个日历年实际商业交付的组件功率，并对照原题质保条件。计划产能、累计多年销量和试验组件应分别处理；全球部署多数则需要另一套行业统计。

Check actual commercial module power delivered by one manufacturer in one calendar year, with the contract’s warranty conditions. Planned capacity, multiyear totals and pilots differ, as does global deployment share.

title: 效率、产能与年度出货
Efficiency, capacity and annual shipments
body: 新增 >30% 商业效率与 1 GW 单年出货两条曲线。首发产品 24.5% 组件效率、同文纪录 26.9%、GW 级规划产能与有质保的年度出货是四种记录。湿热、紫外、封装和寿命资料影响质保判断，不把单个实验室效率纪录作为全部商业条件。

Two added curves concern >30% commercial efficiency and 1 GW annual shipment. The 24.5% shipped module, 26.9% record, planned capacity and warrantied shipments are four records. Damp heat, UV, encapsulation and lifetime inform warranties; a record alone establishes no complete commercial case.

label: 首批商业组件效率
First commercial-module efficiency
scope: Oxford PV 72 片叠层组件的企业披露，不是单片电池效率。
Company-reported 72-cell tandem module efficiency, not a single-cell efficiency.

label: 同公告提及的组件纪录
Module record cited in the same announcement
scope: 组件纪录与首发产品 24.5% 分开，不能把纪录标为出货产品效率。
Keep the record distinct from the 24.5% shipped product.

title: 钠离子电池
Sodium-ion batteries
deck: 比能量、低温表现与客户交付，分开核对。
Check specific energy, cold performance and customer delivery separately.
about: 钠离子在正负极材料之间迁移完成储能；材料体系、硬碳负极和电解液会影响性能。资源与成本潜力不能自动转为更低商品价格，车型发布与实际交付也应分别记录。

Sodium-ion storage shuttles ions between electrodes. Electrode chemistry, hard carbon and electrolyte affect performance. Resource advantages do not automatically establish product prices, and launches differ from delivery.
questions: 指标对应电芯、电池包还是车辆？
Does the metric describe a cell, pack or vehicle?
低温容量、放电功率与循环寿命分别测了吗？
Are cold capacity, power and cycle life measured separately?
是否已有符合原题条件的零售客户交付？
Are there qualifying retail customer deliveries?

title: 钠离子与锂离子的材料差别
Materials differences from lithium-ion
body: 钠离子体系不能只靠“未检出锂”确认；需核对正负极物相、载流离子及电解液。产业比较还涉及压实密度、首周效率、低温性能、封装和系统质量。

Absence of lithium alone does not establish sodium-ion chemistry; verify electrode phases, charge carriers and electrolyte. Compaction, first-cycle efficiency, cold behavior, packaging and system mass also matter.

title: 为何历史市场可能给出不同结算
Why historical contracts can resolve differently
body: “有钠离子商品”“当年向付费用户交车”与“主流车企销售典型乘用车”并不相同。四个原题保留各自范围与平台结算，不合并成一个技术是否成功的结论。
A commercial sodium product, paid vehicle delivery and typical passenger-car sales by a major manufacturer differ. Each of the four contracts retains its own scope and source resolution.

title: 低温数据怎样比较
Comparing cold-performance data
body: 容量保持率需说明参照温度、倍率和截止电压；低温瞬时功率不能代替长周期容量保持。企业公告未给出的完整测试协议继续列为待核查事项。
Retention needs a reference temperature, rate and cutoff voltage. Cold peak power does not replace cycle retention, and protocols absent from company releases remain unverified.

title: 性能发布与可订购价格
Performance releases and orderable prices
body: 新增 ≤10 美元/kWh 市场把单价、标称能量、汇率和网页存档放在同一判定链。2021 年第一代产品的比能量与快充条件仅作历史材料参照；不把市场背景的廉价电池说法作为厂家报价，也不与不同代产品的密度数值拼成“最佳电池”。

The ≤$10/kWh contract links unit price, nominal energy, exchange rates and web archives. Historical first-generation performance is a materials reference, not a manufacturer quotation or a composite best battery assembled from different generations.

label: Naxtra 质量比能量
Naxtra specific energy
scope: 企业披露最高值；不能直接与整包或其他工况比较。
Company-reported maximum; not directly comparable to packs or other conditions.

label: 所发布车型纯电续航
Announced vehicle range
scope: 车型级表述；页面未给出完整测试循环。
Vehicle-level claim; the release does not specify a complete test cycle.

label: −40 °C 容量保持率
Capacity retention at −40 °C
scope: 企业低温性能披露，不是常温循环寿命。
Company cold-performance claim, not ambient cycle lifetime.

label: 第一代钠离子单体比能量
First-generation sodium-ion specific energy
scope: CATL 当年电芯发布口径，不是整包数据，也不是价格。
Historical CATL cell claim, not pack-level energy or price.

label: 第一代钠离子快充披露
First-generation sodium-ion charging claim
scope: 室温；公告此句未提供完整起始 SOC 与充电曲线，非所有产品统一能力。
Room temperature; this statement lacks a full starting-SOC/charging curve and is not universal to all products.

title: 动力电池与规模储能
EV batteries & grid storage
deck: 从 LFP 份额、单体比能量，到电池包成本与储能规模。
From LFP share and cell energy to pack cost and grid-scale storage.
about: 这一专题将动力电池材料与电网储能分别计量。正极路线影响成本与能量密度，整包还包含结构、热管理和控制；储能项目同时需要功率、能量、效率与寿命。

This topic measures EV chemistry and grid storage separately. Cathodes affect cost and energy density, while packs add structures, thermal systems and control. Storage also needs power, energy, efficiency and lifetime.
questions: 价格按单体还是整包、额定还是可用能量计？
Does price concern a cell or pack and rated or usable energy?
LFP 份额用生产出货还是注册装车统计？
Does LFP share use production shipments or registered deployment?
储能规模是 GW 功率、GWh 能量还是实际放电量？
Is storage measured as GW, GWh or actual delivered energy?

title: 电芯与系统的分母
Cell and system boundaries
body: Wh/kg 与 Wh/L 分别描述质量和体积指标。把电芯装入电池包会增加连接、支撑和热管理，不能将单体纪录原样用于整包。成本模型也必须说明币值年份、规模和可用能量。

Wh/kg and Wh/L measure different denominators. Packs add interconnections, supports and thermal systems, so cell records do not carry over unchanged. Cost models need currency year, scale and usable-energy scope.

title: 功率、能量和时长
Power, energy and duration
body: GW 表示瞬时功率能力，GWh 表示储能量；能量除以功率得到名义时长，但不能替代实测可用时长和效率。市场设定的 130 GWh 基线属于规则常数，不被写成本站核实的历史统计。

GW measures power and GWh energy. Their ratio gives nominal duration, not verified usable duration or efficiency. The contract’s fixed 130 GWh baseline is a rule constant, not a historical statistic verified here.

title: 全钒液流与关键材料
Vanadium flow and material demand
body: 全钒液流通过不同价态电解液反应储能，储罐和电堆分别影响能量与功率。用钒份额须按钒元素含量核算，并区分电解液库存、当年消费与钢铁等其他用途。

Vanadium flow stores energy through redox couples; tanks and stacks affect energy and power differently. Consumption shares need contained-V accounting and separation of inventory, annual use and non-battery applications.

title: 部署规模与关键原料供应
Deployment and critical-material supply
body: 新增中国新型储能功率、全球钒产量和美国电池级锂份额三类市场。功率 GW、能量 GWh、元素吨与电池级 LCE 属于不同单位和供应环节。统计版次、年份和回收重复计量会改变对比，未来设计能力与真实合格产出分列。

New contracts cover Chinese storage power, global vanadium output and US battery-grade lithium share. GW, GWh, contained-metal tonnes and battery-grade LCE describe different units/stages. Editions, years and recycling double counting matter; design capacity is not qualified output.

label: 电池包制造成本估计
Estimated pack manufacturing cost
scope: 轻型车电池包，可用能量口径。
Light-duty packs, usable-energy basis.

label: 电池包制造成本估计
Estimated pack manufacturing cost
scope: 假设年产至少 10 万套，非零售价格。
At least 100,000 packs/year; not retail price.

label: 全球 EV 电池部署
Global EV battery deployment
scope: IEA 行业统计；不等于工厂名义年产能。
IEA sector statistic; not factory nameplate capacity.

label: LFP 部署份额
LFP deployment share
scope: 按新注册 EV 电池容量；LFP 含 LMFP。
New EV registration capacity; LFP includes LMFP.

label: 锂离子名义制造能力
Li-ion nameplate manufacturing capacity
scope: 制造能力与实际产出、装车量分别统计。
Manufacturing capability differs from output and deployment.

label: 美国公用事业级电池功率
US utility-scale battery power
scope: 功率指标；不包括全部分布式储能。
Power, not energy; not all distributed storage.

label: 当年新增电池功率
Battery power added that year
scope: 新增量，不是累计存量或 GWh。
Annual addition, not cumulative stock or GWh.

label: 凝聚态单体比能量
Condensed-cell specific energy
scope: 企业技术发布；商业供应另需核实。
Company technology announcement; availability requires separate evidence.

label: 中国新型储能投运功率
China operating new-type storage power
scope: 已建成投运的新型储能，包含多技术路线；不是产线年产能。
Operational aggregate across technologies, not annual manufacturing capacity.

label: 中国新型储能投运能量
China operating new-type storage energy
scope: 原文 1.68 亿 kWh 的单位换算；与 73.76 GW 功率分列。
Converted from the source’s 168 million kWh; separate from 73.76 GW power.

title: 清洁制氢与电解水
Clean hydrogen & electrolysis
deck: 核对制氢成本、实际电解装机和产量。
Inspect hydrogen costs, commissioned electrolysis and production.
about: 电解水以电能驱动产氢和产氧反应，电极催化剂、膜与电堆决定效率和稳定性。是否低排放还取决于供电和完整生产路径；“清洁氢”“可再生氢”与“电解氢”范围并不完全相同。

Electrolysis uses electricity to drive hydrogen and oxygen evolution. Catalysts, membranes and stacks determine efficiency and durability. Emissions depend on electricity and production pathways; clean, renewable and electrolytic hydrogen are not identical categories.
questions: 成本是平准化制造成本还是销售价格？
Is the metric levelized production cost or selling price?
装机是已投运电输入功率还是设备年制造能力？
Is capacity commissioned electrical input or annual manufacturing?
产氢量是否包含化石路线与碳捕集？
Does output include fossil routes with capture?

title: 电极催化与系统能耗
Catalysis and system energy
body: 降低析氢、析氧过电位有助于减少电堆损失，但项目还包含水处理、压缩、冷却与电力采购。单个催化剂的低过电位不能直接给出每公斤商品氢的完整成本。

Lower electrode overpotentials reduce stack losses, but projects include water treatment, compression, cooling and electricity. One catalyst’s overpotential does not establish the cost of delivered hydrogen.

title: 项目清单与实际产量
Project pipelines and actual output
body: 已宣布、最终投资决定、在建与投运是不同状态。相同电解装机在不同利用小时和效率下产生不同氢量；不以 GW 乘全年小时数补造实际年产量。

Announcement, investment decision, construction and commissioning are different states. Identical capacity can yield different output with utilization and efficiency; nameplate capacity is not converted into invented annual production.

title: 目标与市场期限
Targets and contract deadlines
body: DOE 资料中的 2031 年成本目标，与原题的 2030 年价格判定分别保留。政策目标、工程模型和观察到的价格各有用途，不能在结算时互相替代。
DOE’s 2031 cost target and the contract’s 2030 price deadline remain distinct. Policy goals, engineering models and observed prices serve different purposes.

title: 从制氢设施到专用输氢网络
From hydrogen facilities to dedicated networks
body: 新增日本核能制氢与欧洲专用管线市场，分别要求年产量和实际运营长度。HTTR 许可、出口温度和研发日程不能代替产氢统计；德国获批核心网络不能当作已运营欧洲总长度。原有绿氢成本与电解装机市场继续按各自单位和电源条件阅读。

Nuclear-hydrogen and pipeline contracts require annual output and operating mileage. HTTR licensing, temperature and targets are not production statistics; Germany’s approved network is not operating European length. Existing green-hydrogen cost/electrolyser contracts keep their units and power boundaries.

label: 全球已安装电解容量
Global installed electrolysis
scope: IEA 装机口径；不是制造商 GW/年产能。
IEA installed capacity, not manufacturing GW/year.

label: 低排放氢年产量
Annual low-emissions hydrogen
scope: 包含化石配套 CCUS 等路线，不全为绿氢。
Includes fossil routes with CCUS, not solely green hydrogen.

label: 在建电解容量
Electrolysis under construction
scope: 在建不等于已投运；目标开工时间不作完成时间。
Under construction is not commissioned.

label: Hydrogen Shot 成本目标
Hydrogen Shot cost target
scope: 清洁氢研发目标，未写成已经实现的价格。
Clean-hydrogen development target, not an achieved price.

label: HTTR 报告出口温度
Reported HTTR outlet temperature
scope: 热源性能，既不是氢产率，也不证明年度规模化生产。
Heat-source performance, not hydrogen yield or annual production.

label: HTTR 核热制氢目标
HTTR reactor-heat hydrogen target
scope: 受监管审查及设施连接等条件约束，不是完成时间。
Subject to regulatory review and facility coupling, not a completion date.

label: 德国获批氢核心管网长度
Approved German hydrogen-core length
scope: 获批方案范围，不是当时已运营长度，也不是欧洲总计。
Approved plan, not operating mileage or a Europe-wide total.

label: 获批方案天然气管线转换占比
Repurposed-gas share of approved plan
scope: 方案内拟改造比例，不意味着这些管段已完成氢气投运。
Planned repurposing share, not evidence those segments already operate with hydrogen.

title: AI 药物研发与临床验证
AI drug discovery & clinical validation
deck: 从分子设计、早期临床到上市批准，逐项查证。
Follow molecular design, early trials and regulatory approval.
about: AI 可以参与靶点发现、分子生成或蛋白设计，但一项结构预测与具备可开发性的药物之间还需要合成、活性、选择性和安全性验证。专题分别收录临床启动、I 期完成及 FDA 批准预测。

AI can support target discovery, molecular generation and protein design. Developable drugs additionally need synthesis, activity, selectivity and safety evidence. Contracts separately address clinical entry, phase-I completion and FDA approval.
questions: AI 具体参与了靶点、结构还是分子设计？
Did AI contribute to targets, structures or molecular design?
主要终点、样本量、对照与随访是什么？
What are the primary endpoint, sample, control and follow-up?
原题要求试验进展还是实际上市批准？
Does the contract require trial progress or marketing approval?

title: 生成分子之后
After molecular generation
body: 分子还需能够合成，并在实验中表现出活性、选择性及可接受的药代与毒理性质。模型评分、体外结合、动物结果和人体试验回答不同问题，不能互相替代。

A proposed molecule needs synthesis, activity, selectivity and acceptable pharmacokinetic/toxicology results. Model scores, in-vitro binding, animal studies and human trials answer different questions.

title: 如何阅读小样本试验
Reading a small trial
body: 先看预设主要终点，再看次要或探索性终点。Rentosertib IIa 期的 71 名受试者、12 周观察和利益关系披露与结果一同展示，不把短期指标变化直接写成长期疗效结论。

Read the prespecified primary endpoint before secondary or exploratory findings. The 71 participants, 12-week period and interests in the rentosertib trial accompany its results, without inferring long-term benefit.

title: 名称与监管里程碑
Names and regulatory milestones
body: 原市场写作 INS018_055，所引论文写作 ISM001-055／rentosertib；检索时保留拼写差别与来源。进入临床、完成 I 期和 FDA 批准各按原题核对，平台 Yes 不作为监管结论。

The market spells INS018_055 while the paper uses ISM001-055/rentosertib; source spellings are retained. Clinical entry, phase-I completion and FDA approval remain distinct, and a platform Yes is not a regulatory finding.

title: 工具参与、重要贡献与批准
Tool use, material influence and approval
body: 新增 markov.bio 联合条件市场，要求独立的早期研发贡献说明与 FDA/EMA 人用批准，还包含企业退出和归因歧义条款。论文里使用过某工具与工具对上市药物作出重要贡献是不同证据；已有 IIa 期临床数据也不能自动跨到批准。

The added markov.bio contract requires external material-contribution evidence and FDA/EMA approval, plus business-exit and attribution clauses. A paper’s tool use differs from influential development of an approved drug; Phase IIa evidence does not automatically become approval.

label: IIa 期随机入组
Phase 2a randomized participants
scope: 三种给药组各 18 人，安慰剂 17 人。
Three active groups of 18 and placebo group of 17.

label: 试验给药观察期
Trial treatment period
scope: 有限随访；不能推出长期结局。
Limited follow-up; not long-term outcomes.

label: 至少一次治疗期间不良事件
At least one treatment-emergent adverse event
scope: 依次为三种给药组与安慰剂；小样本结果。
Three active arms followed by placebo; small sample.

label: 肺活量 FVC 变化（次要终点）
FVC change (secondary endpoint)
scope: 60 mg once daily / placebo; 95% CIs 10.9–185.9 and −116.1–75.6 mL.

events.originalTitle: Donut Battery is essentially Lithium free?
title: Donut Battery 的锂质量分数会低于 0.1% 吗？
Will the Donut Battery contain less than 0.1% lithium by weight?
rules: 规则以锂质量分数低于 0.1% 为 Yes，达到或超过该值为 No。
Yes requires lithium below 0.1% by weight; at least 0.1% resolves No.
interpretation: 需要能对应到被测电池的第三方成分证据；快充、能量密度或公司“无锂”说法不能替代成分分析。
Independent composition evidence must identify the tested battery. Charging speed, energy density and company descriptions do not establish elemental composition.

summary: 预测的是锂含量，不是测试会不会发生。原题的 Yes 门槛为质量分数低于 0.1%。
This predicts lithium content, not whether testing occurs: Yes requires less than 0.1% by weight.
checklist: 核对 Intertek 原报告的取样范围与质量分母。
Check the Intertek report’s sample scope and mass denominator.
区分送检组分、完整电芯与量产批次，确认它们和题目对象的对应关系。
Match submitted parts, complete cells and production batches to the contract subject.
对照原市场的后续澄清；报告结果不自动替代平台结算。
Review source clarifications; laboratory results do not substitute for platform resolution.

events.originalTitle: Donut Battery powered car delivered by EOY 2030?
title: 指定车企能否在 2030 年内完成 Donut 电池乘用车交付？
Will a listed automaker deliver a Donut-powered passenger vehicle by the end of 2030?
rules: 限原规则列出的 19 家车企、合法上路的量产乘用车，以及明确使用 Donut 主动力电池的车型。至少一名非员工零售客户须实际收车。
Restricted to the 19 named automakers, road-legal production passenger vehicles and an explicitly identified Donut traction battery. A non-employee retail customer must receive a vehicle.
interpretation: 预订、概念车和测试样车不算交付；Verge 摩托车也不在这一乘用车市场的适用范围内。
Preorders, concept cars and test vehicles do not qualify. Verge motorcycles fall outside this passenger-car contract.

summary: 预测零售乘用车是否实际交付。实验电芯存在、摩托车发布和乘用车收车不是同一事件。
This predicts actual retail passenger-car delivery, not a laboratory cell or motorcycle launch.
checklist: 确认车企在原规则 19 家名单内。
Confirm the automaker is in the source list of 19.
找到明确电池型号与已交付车辆的对应记录。
Match the identified battery to a delivered vehicle.
核对非员工零售客户实际收车，而非预订或内部试车。
Verify receipt by a non-employee retail buyer, rather than a preorder or internal test.

events.originalTitle: By the end of 2026, will it be possible to purchase a motorcycle with a solid state battery for <$50k
title: 消费者能否购买低于 5 万美元的固态电池摩托车？
Will a solid-state motorcycle be purchasable below US$50,000?
rules: 原题以 2026 年结束前可以买到符合条件的摩托车为判断对象，价格门槛为 5 万美元。
The original question asks about availability before the end of 2026 with a US$50,000 price ceiling.
interpretation: 购买资格、订单与实际交付并不相同；原描述细则有限，判断前须查看市场创建者的解释。
Availability, ordering and physical delivery differ. The description supplies limited detail; review the creator’s clarifications.

summary: 预测价格低于 5 万美元的固态电池摩托车能否在原题期限内买到；仅七位参与者，规则细节有限。
This asks whether a sub-US$50,000 solid-state motorcycle becomes purchasable by the deadline; activity and rule detail are limited.
checklist: 查价格是否包含原题要求的配置、市场和币种。
Check configuration, jurisdiction and currency against the source rule.
分清可下单、可交付和客户已收到。
Distinguish ordering, availability and receipt.
核实商品所用电池，不能只引用供应商实验样品。
Verify the product’s battery rather than only a supplier’s laboratory cell.

label: 规则细节不足
Limited rule detail
detail: 购买和交付边界需要查看原市场澄清。
Availability versus delivery needs source clarification.

label: 参与较少
Few participants
detail: 概率来自少量参与者；查看成交数量与原始规则。
Few participants contribute; review activity and source rules.

events.originalTitle: Will any OEM be producing LLZO solid-state battery packs at commercial scale (≥1 GWh/year) by December 31, 2029?
title: LLZO 固态电池能否达到 2029 年商业生产门槛？
Will LLZO solid-state packs reach the 2029 commercial-production threshold?
rules: 要求 LLZO 石榴石电解质路线，单个设施年化至少 1 GWh，并核对商业交付及生产运行证据。
Requires LLZO garnet chemistry, at least 1 GWh annualized at a single facility, with commercial-delivery and production evidence.
interpretation: 公告中的未来产能不等于实际运行；硫化物路线或低于门槛的中试生产不满足同一标准。
Announced future capacity is not an operating run rate. Sulfide chemistry and below-threshold pilots do not meet this contract.

summary: 预测 2029 年窗口的 LLZO 商业生产门槛：重点是指定路线和单一设施的实际年化产出。
This is the 2029 LLZO production threshold: specified chemistry and actual annualized output at one facility.
checklist: 确认电解质确为 LLZO；硫化物路线不能混入。
Confirm LLZO chemistry; exclude sulfide routes.
查至少 1 GWh/年运行与商业交付依据，不用设计产能代替。

interpretation: 存档原平台为 No；临床结果、监管认定或受理申请不是上市批准。

checklist: 核对 FDA 实际批准记录与日期。

核对新分子与重要 AI 设计贡献。

body: USGS 提供钒的年度与月度统计入口。核对本题应采用同一年度、同一版次和钒元素含量口径，并查看表注是否包含副产与再生来源。原市场背景同时出现约 119 kt 和 109 kt 的 2024 基数，本站不把其中任何一句改写成已核定的世界产量。

USGS links annual and monthly vanadium statistics. Match year, edition, contained-V units and treatment of co-product/recycled sources. The contract background gives conflicting 2024 baselines of about 119 kt and 109 kt; neither is adopted here as a verified world total.

title: USGS：锂矿产统计与供应链资料
USGS: lithium statistics and supply-chain information
body: 矿山锂金属含量、锂盐精炼量、电池级碳酸锂当量和回收产出属于不同统计环节。本题把美国矿山、精炼与回收都纳入候选来源；需要避免重复计量，并与全球同口径供应量配对。仅有资源储量或已规划精炼产能不足以判定 10% 份额。

Contained lithium in mine output, refining, battery-grade LCE and recycling measure different stages. The contract includes US mines, processing and recycling: avoid double counting and match the global denominator. Resources or planned refinery capacity do not establish the 10% share.

title: JAEA：HTTR 制氢设施的许可申请与目标
JAEA: HTTR hydrogen-facility application and target
kind: 研究机构原始公告 · 许可与研发
body: JAEA 于 2025 年 3 月申请修改 HTTR 设施许可，计划连接制氢设施并在监管审查后争取 2030 年利用反应堆热制氢。公告提及 HTTR 曾达到 950°C 出口温度；这是热源性能，不是年产氢量。该公告没有证明日本已经达到市场的每年 10,000 吨门槛。

JAEA applied in March 2025 to modify the HTTR installation for an attached hydrogen facility, aiming for reactor-heat hydrogen by 2030 after regulatory review. Its reported 950°C outlet temperature describes the heat source, not hydrogen output; the notice does not verify the contract’s 10,000 t/year threshold.

title: 德国联邦网络局：获批氢核心管网与投运规划
Bundesnetzagentur: approved hydrogen core network and schedule
kind: 监管机构公告 · 获批规划
body: 2024 年 10 月获批方案包括 9,040 km 管线，约 60% 拟由天然气管线改造，计划于 2032 年前分步投入运营。这是德国获批规划，既不是当时已投运长度，也不是整个欧洲的运营总量。天然气掺氢与仍未转换投运的管段不满足本轮市场的专用氢管线定义。

The October 2024 approval covers 9,040 km, about 60% converted from gas pipelines, for phased operation by 2032. This is an approved German plan, not operating mileage or a Europe-wide total. Blending and segments awaiting hydrogen conversion do not meet the contract definition.

title: LLNL：2023 年 NIF 靶增益的实验能量
LLNL: measured energies for NIF target gain in 2023
body: 年度报告记录 2023 年 7 月 30 日一次实验：到靶激光 2.05 MJ，聚变输出 3.88 MJ。按披露值相除约 1.89；分母不含激光设施全部用电。这组历史数据说明如何读靶增益，不代表 2023 年所有实验的最大值，也不能推出电站净发电。

The report records 2.05 MJ delivered laser energy and 3.88 MJ fusion output for the 30 July 2023 shot: about 1.89 by division. The denominator excludes whole-facility electricity. This historical shot illustrates target gain, not the maximum of every 2023 shot or net electrical generation.

title: Evered 等：并行中性原子双比特纠缠门
Evered et al.: parallel neutral-atom entangling gates
body: 论文报告在最多 60 个原子上并行实现双比特纠缠门，保真度 99.5%，并以多种重复门测试评估误差。60 指原子数，不是 60 对双比特门；99.5% 也低于本市场 99.9% 的门槛。学术论文结果还需与题目指定的企业团队和截止时间分别对应。

The study reports 99.5% two-qubit entangling fidelity on up to 60 atoms in parallel, benchmarked using repeated-gate methods. Sixty denotes atoms, not sixty gate pairs. The value is below the contract’s 99.9%; corporate-team attribution and the deadline remain separate requirements.

title: Terraform Industries：电转气示范系统
Terraform Industries: integrated power-to-gas demonstrator
kind: 企业原始披露 · 示范与成本口径
Company disclosure · demonstration and stated costs
body: 公司称于 2024 年 3 月 27 日接通电解、直接空气捕集与甲烷化系统，产品甲烷含量 >97%。其 <2.50 美元/kg 制氢与 <250 美元/t 空气捕集成本是企业披露，前者同时给出 20 美元/MWh 直流光伏电价假设。示范运行和甲烷销售均未直接证明本题要求的设备销售；燃料使用后碳会重新释放，不能按永久移除记账。

The company reports commissioning electrolysis, DAC and methanation on 27 March 2024, producing >97% methane. Disclosed costs of <$2.50/kg H₂ and <$250/t captured CO₂ are company claims; the hydrogen calculation cites $20/MWh solar DC electricity. Demonstration or methane sales do not establish equipment sales. Fuel carbon is later released, rather than durably removed.

title: DOE：Carbon Negative Shot 的净移除成本目标
DOE: Carbon Negative Shot net-removal cost target
kind: 政府研发目标 · 2024 年公告
body: 2024 年 10 月公告将 2032 年组合目标表述为每净吨 CO₂ 当量移除与安全储存成本低于 100 美元，并强调测量、报告与核验。它是研发目标；与只计算捕集的企业报价、名义工厂吞吐量、合成燃料产量不在同一核算边界。

The October 2024 notice sets a portfolio goal below $100 per net tonne CO₂-equivalent by 2032, including secure storage and robust MRV. This is a development target, with a different boundary from capture-only cost, nameplate throughput or synthetic-fuel output.
